claims.statement: Logging uses slog everywhere (never fmt.Printf), at critical junctions only (transaction begin/commit, provider calls, worker retries); debug level is not used in production builds.

Prometheus metrics are exposed at /metrics and scraped by the host; per-endpoint counts and latencies come from api_metrics.go middleware, DB pool stats from db_metrics.go, and worker counts/retries/terminal failures from asynq's inspector plus a custom wrapper.

internal/transport/http/response/error_translator.go is the only place that maps domain errors to HTTP status codes and Vietnamese user-facing messages; request id is generated by middleware and propagated through context, the X-Request-Id header, and log fields, with the frontend echoing the same header via the Axios client.

System health and cron health UI surfaces (frontend/src/components/system-health/AllClear.tsx, frontend/src/components/cron-health/CronJobCard.tsx) are polled via TanStack Query and consume the api-server's metrics and a dedicated admin cron endpoint; the page-level entry points live under pages/admin/.
Provider-call logs include wire state, invoice number, and response time but never the full sensitive payload.
